purpose: Measure paired first-submission interface and categorical-documentation responses across four requested Codex model variants on the fixed matched cohort.
modelMetadataSource: Available collaboration-tool model options in the current session, not a provider identity certificate.
versionScope: Exact selected versions available per requested family in this session. No6.1/6.2 Luna variant is offered here; gpt-6-luna is the requested Luna condition. This makes no claim about globally latest provider models. gpt-6.1-sol is excluded by user steering.

additionalRequestedFamilies.reason: Latest user instruction excludes new Claude measurements because of subscription quota. Historical responses remain historical evidence only.

identityPolicy: Record requested model, session ID, returned execution metadata and any observed backend identity separately. Preserve unavailable actual identity as null; never infer it from generated self-identification. No fallback models.

design.cohortSelection: Unchanged historical fixed selector: minimum SHA256(anchor), then item ID, in each suite/WG/family cell of 667 main + 300 drawn extension candidates. All 15 selected extension items belong to admitted297.
design.samplingUnit: Fixed family/WG representative; repeated sessions do not add new independent questions.

generation.context: Fresh context-isolated subject, fork_turns=none, no inherited discussion, gold, model responses or review material.
generation.input: One complete assigned packet, either inline or an exact assigned file path. Subject may read only that exact packet path and may write only its exact assigned output path once. No other filesystem access, repository search, delegation, skills, MCP, network, database access, query examples or feedback. Inspect observed tool traces against the two allowed paths; this is an audited instruction boundary, not a claimed operating-system isolation guarantee.
generation.firstSubmission: One final JSON object containing all50 queries. Preserve raw response and exact query text. No output-informed retries, repairs or rerolls. An invalid or incomplete first submission stays recorded and counts as unanswered for missing queries.
generation.fixedTaskBudget: 50 questions, one batch, one final submission, zero feedback. No numerical wall-clock or token cap is enforced by the subject tool; record actual elapsed time and returned usage when available.
generation.tokenCapReason: The collaboration subject tool exposes requested reasoning effort but no enforceable token cap. Record returned usage when available.
generation.parallelism: Follow schedule assignment order; sessions may overlap within available slots. All16 Codex primaryA sessions commit or reach an administrative terminal state before primary scoring. B is prespecified for every cell and remains planned regardless of A outcomes. Until B completes, report replication pending. B subjects receive no A outcomes or revised prompts. Complete B independently of A scores when resources permit; record any administrative deferral explicitly.
generation.unavailability: Keep rejected/unavailable/timeout requests as separate administrative status. Do not substitute models or regenerate after a response. Transport failures before any response may be marked unavailable, not a model score.

conditions.common: Native frozen schemas, the same50 IDs/questions/fields/order, and the SQL scope to graph assessmentMethod JSON.scope interface mapping appear in both conditions.
conditions.difference: schema_domains adds only the identical joint low-cardinality SQL/Cypher categorical-domain dictionaries. schema_only omits those dictionaries.
conditions.historicalComparison: These newly controlled packets are a separate experiment. They are not identical to the historical667-item generation condition. Prior matched50 responses are historical context and never additional fresh replicates.

execution.scope: Owner-only scoring after global commitment; original native queries executed once, no translated substitutes or repairs.
execution.sql: System python3 Python3.10.12 / SQLite3.37.2; hash-matched exports; mode=ro, PRAGMA query_only=ON.
execution.cypher: Neo4j5.26.0 existing read-only native services; verify server identity and categorical-domain agreement before scored execution.
execution.caps: 60 seconds,2000 rows per query, requested field count.
execution.services: No service start, restart or configuration change by this harness. Owner coordinates any required service availability before execution. Preserve unavailable execution as blocked.
execution.sourcePolicy: Gold and meeting identity rules remain in the original owner-only scorer sources; subject packets contain neither.

analysis.primary: Within each requested model and language, per-item schema_domains minus schema_only identity exact and F1, separately for A/B and35main/15extension. Report paired discordant item counts.
analysis.secondary: Within requested model/condition, paired Cypher-versus-SQL identity exact/F1; execution errors, missing first responses and family/WG cells.
analysis.uncertainty: Descriptive fixed-cohort paired differences. Do not treat the50 strata as an IID sample or pool1600 query responses as independent. No claim of isolated provider/model architecture effect.
analysis.populationSeparation: Report the50-item diagnostic in its own table/figure and caption. Do not append these results to the667-item Figure3 or claim a667/297 population estimate.
analysis.reporting: Publish all prespecified available runs, raw first submissions, execution rows, provenance and paired outcomes, including null/negative results. Make interpretation after measurement.

costPolicy: Codex sessions only; no OpenRouter or paid per-call API experiments.
